g.text: TPR = detection rate • FPR = false-alarm rate on clean cases

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607285

g.text: *Accuracy = correct answers on 41 positive + 66 clean cases, pooled across both objectives.

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607285

g.text: Sampled: 428 answers across those cases. Most likely: 107 answers. Other scoring groups excluded.

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607285

g.text: Same 75 rollouts. Qwen generates four analyses; GLiDE samples four labels from one probability vector.

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607285

g.text: G-mean² = TPR × (1 − FPR). Different input processing; no matching most-likely Qwen evaluation.
